# Technology, Magic & Items

## Abraham Lincoln {#abraham-lincoln}

The Abraham Lincoln is a high-speed, steam-powered [American](../codex/factions.md#american) frigate commanded by [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md), equipped with high-pressure engines and an array of advanced hunting weapons for an expedition to hunt down a legendary giant marine monster.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P22](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P23](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0023), +37 more_

**Used by:** [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md)

## Astrolabe {#astrolabe}

The Astrolabe was a French corvette sent on a circumnavigation voyage under [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) in 1785, which subsequently ran aground and was wrecked on the reefs of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P22](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P23](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), +25 more_

**Used by:** [Urville](../character/urville.md)

## Columbus {#columbus}

The Columbus was a vessel belonging to the West India and [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Steam Navigation Company that encountered a mysterious, rapidly moving aquatic phenomenon in the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean on July 23, 1866.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +5 more_

## Governor Higginson {#governor-higginson}

The Governor Higginson is a steamer belonging to the [Calcutta](../codex/places.md#calcutta) and Burnach Steam Navigation Company that encountered a mysterious aquatic moving mass off the east coast of [Australia](../codex/places.md#australia) in July 1866.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +5 more_

## Helvetia {#helvetia}

The Helvetia is a Compagnie-Nationale ship measuring three hundred feet over all that, alongside the [Shannon](../codex/tech.md#shannon), observed and reported a mysterious sea monster in the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 PART ONE P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), +14 more_

## Moravian {#moravian}

The Moravian is a vessel of the Montreal Ocean Company featuring a hull of superior strength.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 PART ONE P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 PART ONE P10](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0010), [v1 PART ONE P11](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0011), +6 more_

## Nautilus {#nautilus}

The Nautilus is a double-hulled, cigar-shaped submarine vessel measuring 232 feet in length, constructed from steel plates and powered entirely by electricity extracted from sea water.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P99](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0099), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P100](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0100), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P101](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0101), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P102](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0102), +85 more_

**Used by:** [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)

## Recherche {#recherche}

The Recherche was a French merchantman sent under Bruni d'Entrecasteaux in 1791 to search for [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md), as well as the name given to a vessel provided by the Asiatic Society and Indian Company to Captain [Dillon](../character/dillon.md) in 1827, which successfully recovered relics from La Perouse's shipwreck at [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P16](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P18](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P19](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0019), +17 more_

## Rouquayrol {#rouquayrol}

Invented by two Frenchmen and perfected by Captain Nemo, the Rouquayrol apparatus is a back-mounted iron reservoir that stores compressed air and delivers it to a copper helmet via pipes to allow divers to breathe underwater for several hours.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P42](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P43](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P44](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P45](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0045), +17 more_

## Ruhmkorff {#ruhmkorff}

The Ruhmkorff apparatus is a lighting device worn on the body—consisting of a sodium-worked Bunsen pile, a wire, and a lantern with a carbonic gas spiral glass—that generates a continuous white light powered by electricity to illuminate underwater environments.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P46](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P47](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P48](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P49](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0049), +6 more_

## Scotia {#scotia}

The Scotia is a Cunard Company vessel divided into seven compartments, featuring iron plates 1-3/8 inches thick, which survived being struck and perforated by an unknown sharp object in April 1867.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P11](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0011), [v1 PART ONE P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 PART ONE P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 PART ONE P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), +12 more_

**Used by:** [Anderson](../character/anderson.md)

## Shannon {#shannon}

The Shannon is a 300-foot vessel belonging to the Royal Mail Steamship Company that co-signalled the sighting of a mysterious, gigantic sea creature in the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 PART ONE P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), +5 more_
